body.name: \(\widehat\Omega_n\)
body.construction: On the variance-training set \(\mathcal V_n\), compute each untreated residual \(\widehat e_{it}\) from the rank-\(r\) Choi--Yuan completion and debiasing fit with cell \((i,t)\) deleted, and set \(\widehat\sigma_i^2=h_i^{-1}\sum_{t\in H_i}\widehat e_{it}^2\). Estimate the exact influence coefficients \(\widehat c_{kq}\), and set \(\widehat\Omega_{kk'}=\sum_{q=(u,v)\in\mathcal Q_n^{\mathrm{IF}}}\widehat c_{kq}\widehat c_{k'q}\widehat\sigma_u^2\) for all \(k,k'\in\mathcal K_n\); no variance-training cell outside \(\mathcal Q_n^{\mathrm{IF}}\) enters this influence sum.
